definitions: To make something smooth, shiny, or sleek, often by applying a substance.
To make hair smooth and flat, typically with a styling product.
To make something neat or orderly.
To move or slide smoothly and easily.
examples: He slicked his hair back for the interview.
She slicked the surface of the table with polish.
The car slicked around the corner.
They slicked the deck to make it less slippery.
